backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all core data types (UserProfile, Post, Comment, Poll, Group, Notification, LocalIssue, etc.) and including mixins for blob storage and authorization for the CivWorld platform.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a single high-confidence feature: fixing the comment action dropdown menu clipping issue in CommentSection.tsx using portal-based or viewport-aware positioning.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key implementation details of each component, page, and hook in the CivWorld frontend.
frontend/ANDROID_BRANDING_ASSETS.md: Documents the source branding assets (app icon, adaptive icon foreground/background, splash screen) stored in public/assets/generated/ and how they are used to generate Android native resources for the Capacitor build.
frontend/ANDROID_PLAY_STORE_BUILD.md: Step-by-step guide for building a production Android App Bundle (AAB) for Google Play Store submission, covering prerequisites, signing key creation, and build steps.
frontend/android/.gitignore: Git ignore rules for the Android project, excluding IDE files, build outputs, keystore/signing files, NDK artifacts, and Capacitor config.
frontend/android/keystore/README.md: Documentation-only README explaining what an Android keystore is and how to create one using keytool; instructs developers not to store actual keystore files in this directory.
frontend/capacitor.config.ts: Capacitor configuration for the CivWorld Android app, setting the app ID, web directory, allowed ICP navigation URLs, mixed content policy, and splash screen plugin options.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including background, foreground, primary, chart, and sidebar color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the CivWorld frontend, setting viewport meta tags for mobile/Capacitor compatibility and mounting the React app via /src/main.tsx.
frontend/scripts/android-build.sh: Bash script automating the CivWorld Android build pipeline: builds the web app with pnpm, syncs to Android via Capacitor, then builds either a debug APK or a signed release AAB depending on the argument passed.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application file that sets up React Query, TanStack Router with all page routes, and wraps the app in ThemeProvider and ViewProvider with a shared Layout containing Header and BottomNav.
Installs a shim that intercepts window.open calls in Capacitor to redirect Internet Identity authentication URLs to the Capacitor Browser plugin instead of the WebView.
frontend/src/capacitor/README.md: Guide for building CivWorld as an Android app using Capacitor, listing prerequisites like Android Studio, JDK 17+, and Capacitor CLI.
frontend/src/capacitor/runtime.ts: Provides platform detection utilities (isCapacitor, getPlatform, isAndroid, isIOS) that safely check the Capacitor runtime environment.
frontend/src/capacitor/TROUBLESHOOTING_I: Troubleshooting guide for Internet Identity authentication issues on Android, covering symptoms and diagnosis for common problems like a non-responsive login button.
frontend/src/components/AnalyticsDashboa: Displays a user analytics dashboard with stat cards for posts, likes, poll votes, and followers, plus sections for trending hashtags, top posts, and top contributors.
frontend/src/components/BadgeDisplay.tsx: Renders a row of badge icons with tooltips for a given list of badge IDs, supporting configurable sizes and a maximum display count with overflow indicator.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with five items (Home, Reels, Discuss, Polls, Communities) that highlights the active route using TanStack Router's location.
frontend/src/components/BuildInfoIndicat: Small UI component that displays the current build ID retrieved from a utility function.
frontend/src/components/ChatWindow.tsx: Chat UI component that shows a message thread with another user, fetches messages via React Query, and provides a (currently disabled) message input with send functionality.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Renders a threaded comment section for a post, supporting add/edit/delete/like/unlike/reply actions and a report modal, with skeleton loading states and dropdown menus per comment.
frontend/src/components/CreateDiscussion: Modal dialog for creating a new discussion with fields for category, title, context, and region, using the useCreateDiscussion mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupModal: Modal form for creating a new group with name, description, and optional cover image upload (with progress tracking) via the useCreateGroup mutation.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupPageM: Simple selection modal that lets the user choose between navigating to the create-group or create-page route.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupPostM: Modal for composing and submitting a post (text and optional image) within a specific group, with image preview and upload progress display.
frontend/src/components/CreatePostCard.t: Inline card component for creating a new post with text, image, or video media, including upload progress and optional group association.
frontend/src/components/CVTBalanceCard.t: Card component displaying a user's CVT token balance with a gradient background and disabled buttons for transaction history and transfer actions.
frontend/src/components/DashboardCards.t: Displays two dashboard cards showing the user's Civic Token (CVT) balance and verification status, with loading skeleton states while fetching the user profile.
frontend/src/components/EditConstituency: A modal dialog that allows users to update their constituency/location using a hierarchical location selector, converting between comma-separated and arrow-separated formats before saving.
frontend/src/components/EditPostModal.ts: A modal dialog for editing an existing post's text and media (image/video), supporting upload progress tracking and displaying existing media if no new file is selected.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: A modal form for editing the user's profile name, bio, and location using a hierarchical location selector, saving changes via the saveProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/EditProfilePictu: A modal for uploading, previewing, or removing a user's profile photo, with image validation, processing, and upload progress tracking before saving.
frontend/src/components/GroupsPagesFAB.t: An empty component file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: A sticky app header with the CivWorld logo, an App/Wallet view toggle for authenticated users, and login/logout, profile, and admin navigation buttons.
frontend/src/components/HierarchicalLoca: A multi-level location selector component (country → state → district → MP/MLA constituency) with searchable dropdowns that fetch data via custom query hooks.
frontend/src/components/HorizontalNav.ts: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/PartnershipBanne: A simple banner component displaying a 'Partnership Program' promotional message with a gradient background and sparkle icon.
frontend/src/components/PollCard.tsx: Displays a poll with voting options, shows results as progress bars after voting, and tracks vote status per authenticated user via query hooks.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Renders a social media post card with like/unlike, comments, share, edit, delete, and report actions, supporting image and video content.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog for new users to set up their profile with name, bio, and hierarchical location fields, saving via a mutation hook.
A styled promotional card encouraging users to explore civic communities, with a navigation button linking to the communities route.
frontend/src/components/QuickPostBar.tsx: A post creation bar that opens a dialog for composing text posts with optional image or video attachments, supporting upload progress and group targeting.
frontend/src/components/ReportModal.tsx: A modal dialog component that allows users to report a post, comment, or profile by selecting a reason and optionally adding details, then submitting via the useSubmitReport mutation hook.
Displays a horizontally scrollable list of trending hashtags fetched via useGetTrendingHashtags, supporting selection highlighting and navigation to topic pages.
frontend/src/components/VerificationStat: A card component that shows whether a user's account is verified or not, with styled indicators and a disabled action button for verification details or initiating verification.
frontend/src/components/VerifiedBadge.ts: A small icon component that renders a checkmark badge with a tooltip indicating a verified account, supporting three size variants.
frontend/src/components/WalletView.tsx: Displays the user's Civic Token balance, disabled send/receive action buttons, a coming-soon notice, and an empty recent activity section.
frontend/src/context/ViewContext.tsx: Provides a React context for toggling between 'app' and 'wallet' views, exposing the current view state and a setter via the useView hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication via AuthClient, providing a React context and hook with login/logout functions and status flags for managing ICP user identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocationQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching hierarchical location data (countries, states, districts, MP/MLA constituencies, mandals, villages) from the backend actor, with appropriate caching and enabled conditions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Central collection of React Query hooks and mutations for all major data entities (user profiles, posts, polls, comments, groups, pages, reports, etc.), including error formatting and cache invalidation logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the design system including light/dark theme tokens, brand colors (saffron, deep blue), and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays reported content in a tabbed interface, allowing admins to delete reported posts/comments and suspend users, with helper functions for formatting report reason, target type, and status labels.
frontend/src/pages/CommunitiesPage.tsx: Page listing all groups and pages in a tabbed layout, with card components for each, a create menu button, and loading/empty states, navigating to individual group or page detail routes on click.
frontend/src/pages/CreateGroupPage.tsx: A form page for creating a new group with fields for name, description, and optional cover image upload, using the useCreateGroup mutation and navigating to /communities on success.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePagePage.tsx: A form page for creating a new community page with fields for name, category (dropdown), description, privacy toggle, and optional profile image upload, using the useCreatePage mutation.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePollPage.tsx: A form page for creating a poll with a question, 2–6 answer options, and a public/private toggle, using the useCreatePoll mutation and navigating to /polls on success.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Displays a feed of discussion posts fetched via useGetPosts, with a CreatePostCard for authenticated users and loading/empty states.
frontend/src/pages/EducationPage.tsx: A civic education page with static sample learning modules and quizzes, supporting tab switching between modules and quizzes and a detail view for individual modules.
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: A placeholder Events & Campaigns page displaying a 'Coming Soon' card that outlines planned features like event creation, RSVP, location-based discovery, and reminders.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Explore page with three tabs—Trending (top 10 posts by likes), Groups (list of all groups), and Analytics—using React Query hooks to fetch and display data.
frontend/src/pages/GroupDetailPage.tsx: Detail page for a single group showing cover image, description, member count, join/leave actions, and a feed of group posts with a create-post modal.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsAndPagesPage.ts: Combined listing page with tabs for Groups and Pages, fetching both collections and navigating to their respective detail routes.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsPage.tsx: Simple groups listing page that fetches all groups and renders each as a navigable card, with a create-group button for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main feed page rendering promotional banners, trending section, a constituency shortcut, a quick-post bar for logged-in users, and a paginated list of posts.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Messaging page where users enter a Principal ID to start a direct conversation, then renders a ChatWindow component for that user.
frontend/src/pages/MyAreaPage.tsx: A page for reporting and viewing local community issues, with a form to submit new issues (title, description, location) and a list displaying each issue's status (new, inReview, resolved). Requires Internet Identity authentication to submit reports.
frontend/src/pages/MyConstituencyPage.ts: Displays the user's political constituency hierarchy (country, state, district, MP/MLA constituencies) parsed from their profile location, with an edit button that opens an EditConstituencyModal.
frontend/src/pages/PageDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a single community page fetched by ID, including its profile image, name, category, description, privacy status, owner, and creation date.
frontend/src/pages/PagesPage.tsx: Lists all community pages fetched from the backend with their image, name, and category, and provides a button to navigate to the page creation flow.
frontend/src/pages/PollsPage.tsx: Displays a list of civic polls using PollCard components, with loading skeletons, an error state, an empty state, and a button to navigate to poll creation.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Renders the authenticated user's profile with their photo, bio, location, follower/post/token stats, and tabbed sections for their posts and an analytics dashboard, plus modals for editing profile info and picture.
frontend/src/pages/ReelPage.tsx: A placeholder page indicating that a short-form video (Reels) feature is coming soon, displaying a styled icon and descriptive text.
frontend/src/pages/SharePage.tsx: A content creation page that renders a CreatePostCard and placeholder cards for Event Creation and Video Upload (both marked as coming soon), navigating home after a post is created.
frontend/src/pages/TopicPage.tsx: Displays posts filtered by a hashtag topic extracted from the URL params, showing a loading spinner or empty state as appropriate.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: Shows a user's profile info, their posts, follow/unfollow controls, and a report modal, fetching data via principal-based query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPage.tsx: A placeholder page for a video feed that displays a 'Coming Soon' message with a video icon.
frontend/src/pages/VideoReelsPage.tsx: A TikTok-style vertical scroll reel page using mock video data, with like, comment, and share interactions per reel.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx: Displays the user's CVT token balance, CivPoints summary, verification status, and wallet details, requiring authentication to view.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPointsPage.tsx: Shows the user's CivPoints balance, daily/total earned stats, level, and a transaction history list fetched from the wallet query hooks.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: Defines all shared TypeScript interfaces and enums for the frontend, including UserProfile, Post, Comment, Poll, Group, Notification, LocalIssue, and discussion types.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrors.ts: Provides centralized error handling utilities that parse IC/Candid error formats and map them to user-friendly English messages.
frontend/src/utils/buildId.ts: Extracts a runtime build identifier from loaded script URLs to help diagnose stale-client issues after redeployment.
frontend/src/utils/candidOption.ts: Utility functions for normalizing and validating MediaContent payloads before sending to the backend, ensuring proper Candid optional serialization.
frontend/src/utils/profilePhotoValidatio: Validates profile photo files (type and size) and processes them by cropping to a centered square and compressing to JPEG via canvas.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color tokens (saffron, deep-blue, sidebar, chart), font families, border radii, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/WALLET_VISIBILITY_AUDIT.md: Audit report documenting that wallet UI (WalletPage, /wallet route, Header and BottomNav navigation entries) was missing and describing the resolutions added in this build, plus a runtime build ID utility for deployment verification.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state, noting a known bug where the comment Edit/Delete dropdown menu is clipped due to overflow/positioning issues, with a fix request targeting portal-based or viewport-aware rendering.
